mapper.insert: INSERT INTO antagonisms (id, piece_code, piece_name, antagonism_piece_codes, antagonism_piece_names, type, remark, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{pieceCode}, #{pieceName}, #{antagonismPieceCodes}, #{antagonismPieceNames}, #{type}, #{remark}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE antagonisms SET piece_code = #{pieceCode}, piece_name = #{pieceName}, antagonism_piece_codes = #{antagonismPieceCodes}, antagonism_piece_names = #{antagonismPieceNames}, type = #{type}, remark = #{remark}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id}
